profile_change_name_body: This is how you appear to other players in lobbies and games. Choose a nickname of up to 12 characters.
bonus_round_desc: In this round we won't show the question everyone answered. Keep your question secret — no one will know for sure they're not the impostor. Only the results and who voted for whom will be shown. Think harder before you vote!
tutorial_pass_around_1: Each player takes the phone, reads their question, types their answer, then hands it off.
tutorial_pass_around_3: And if you peek — you're the real villain here.
tutorial_twist_1: Most of you got the same question, but one of you got a different one.
tutorial_twist_2: You think you're answering the same thing... then the question is revealed.
tutorial_twist_3: That's when the odd one realizes 'Oh, no, it's me!'
tutorial_accuse_1: You've got time to call each other out - point at people, overanalyze, yell 'YOU!' dramatically, the whole deal.
tutorial_accuse_2: When the timer ends, vote for the impostor.
tutorial_accuse_3: Trust no one. Or make them all trust you!
round_start_hint: Click START once the phone is in your hands.
results_hold_timer_skip: Hold the timer until it fills up to skip

pass_device_sub: Hand the phone to next player

htp_gather_1: Get your friends together — in one room or on a quick call or video chat.
htp_gather_2: You'll need to talk, bluff, and overanalyze everything.
htp_party_1: You're all together, so one phone is enough: pass it from player to player.
htp_party_2: Each player answers in secret — hold "It's me" only when the phone is in your hands and nobody is looking.
htp_online_1: Not in the same room? Jump on a quick call or video chat — you'll need to talk, bluff and argue.
htp_online_2: Everyone plays on their own phone: one hosts, the rest join with the room code.
htp_cam_setup_1: Stand the phone up where its camera can see all of you.
htp_cam_setup_2: Everyone enters a name, picks a colour and takes a selfie.
htp_cam_question_1: Pass the phone around: each player peeks at their question alone.
htp_cam_question_2: One of you secretly gets a *different* question — and doesn't know it yet.
htp_cam_point_1: Put the phone back down. On the countdown, everyone points at their answer at the same time.
htp_cam_point_2: Then the real question appears — and the Impostor finds out it's them.
htp_cam_point_3: Talk it over, then point at who you think the Impostor is.
htp_cam_lives_1: Caught the Impostor? They lose a life. Missed? Everyone else loses one.
htp_cam_lives_2: When two players are left, the one with more lives wins — and the round photos are yours to keep.
htp_question_1: Each player gets a question — except one who secretly gets a *different* one.
htp_question_2: That person is the Impostor… but even they don't know it yet! Everyone answers truthfully — no lying yet!
htp_discuss_1: All answers appear. Talk, argue, defend, and accuse.
htp_discuss_2: This is when the Impostor finally sees the real question — and realizes it's them. Now they must blend in… or fake it till they make it.
htp_vote_1: When time's up, everyone votes who they think the Impostor is.
htp_vote_2: Votes are revealed — but the suspense stays until the end! Did you catch it?
htp_reveal_1: The true Impostor is revealed — and so is their secret question!
htp_reveal_2: Laugh, scream, or cry — depends on how well you guessed.
htp_reveal_3: Then brace yourself for a new round of chaos.

gameplay_refresh_body: This will reload only the current screen and keep you in the same place in the game.
deathmatch_settings_sub: These are the only two things you choose. The game picks the time.
deathmatch_settings_single_hint: One attempt each. Closer wins the duel.
deathmatch_settings_best_of_3_hint: First to win two rounds. A new time every round.

deathmatch_htp_rule_1: The game picks a target time, for example 5.0 seconds.
deathmatch_htp_rule_2: One after the other: tap START, then tap STOP as close to the target as you can.
deathmatch_htp_rule_3: Play with the seconds showing, or blind: the timer hides after the first second.
deathmatch_htp_rule_4: Closest to the target wins the round. Win the duel to win the game!
deathmatch_settings_visible_hint: The timer stays visible the whole time
deathmatch_pass_locked: {{name}} has played. Now it's your turn.

cam_record_body: Tap to start, tap again to pause; the recording ends by itself with the round. The video shows the whole screen — your faces, the questions and the countdowns. You'll find it in your phone's gallery, and you can watch it here under “Photos & video” after the round and at the end of the game.
cam_record_unavailable: Screen recording works only in the installed app, not in Expo Go. Make a new build to use it.
